g.text: Forebrain expression states and limits of within-state inference
RR8: 23,036 retained cells from eight mice. State labels are numerical; exposure and age were excluded from feature selection and clustering.
B: outlined rows have at least 50 cells from every mouse. Depth sensitivity regresses cell UMI and mitochondrial fraction from PCs; state numbers do not match across fits.
C: circles = limma/voom with 95% moderated intervals; squares = edgeR QL. Filled = full-family q < 0.05. Finer depth-sensitive states weaken PYCARD support.
D: HC3 mouse-level intervals; filled = q < 0.05 among 1,812 planned tests. Equal weights use sparse observed states (minimum 9 cells). Flight and processing day remain confounded.
